heading: Connect Instagram
body: Tagly pays you for posts from the places you visit. To reward you for them, connect your Instagram account.
why: Why do I need a professional account?
skipAlertBody: You can connect Instagram later in Settings, but you won't be able to earn until you do.
failedNote: Page didn't load or get stuck? Instagram sometimes fails, but incognito mode should fix it.
takenBody: This Instagram is already connected to another Tagly account. Do you want to log in to that account instead?
whyHeading: Why do I need a professional account?
whyBody: Instagram only lets you connect professional accounts, not regular ones.
whyBenefits: What are the perks of a professional account?
whyInsightsBody: Instagram shows you more stats on how your posts are doing.
whyFreeBody: Switching to a professional account is free, and you can switch back to personal anytime.
whyPrivacyBody: Tagly only reads your insights to work out your reward. We never post, edit your account, message anyone, or see your password or DMs.
